basic_info.description: Located in a classic 3-unit Marina building, 3622 Broderick #1 is a beautifully updated full-floor 3BD/2BA condo blending timeless architecture with modern comforts. Period details like box beam ceilings, wood floors, and a brick fireplace enhance the bright living room. The open living and dining floor plan offers an ideal space for both entertaining and everyday living. The chef's kitchen features a Wolf range, Sub-Zero fridge, Bosch dishwasher, and ample storage. The spacious primary suite offers generous closet space and an en-suite bath. Two additional bedrooms provide flexibility for guests, family, or a home office. Enjoy elevator access directly into the unit, in-unit laundry, deeded storage, and garage parking with a Tesla charger. Shared amenities include a rooftop deck with sweeping city views, a common backyard, and a private patio ideal for morning coffee or evening relaxation. Located just moments from the Marina Green, Palace of Fine Arts, Crissy Field, and Chestnut Street's vibrant shops, dining, and cafes. With its rare combination of space, location, architecture, and premium features, this home truly checks every box in one of San Francisco's most iconic neighborhoods.
